name: 21220 · Middle River, MD
findings: ZIP 21220 (Middle River) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21220 (Middle River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
